title: Gate in a workspace: each package is checked with its own issues
description: pkg_a has 1 HIGH issue and [gate] failOnSeverity = "HIGH"; pkg_b has 2 LOW issues and [gate] failOnCount = 5. From 0.13.0 a command-line gate option replaces each package's whole [gate], so a setting left off the command line is not read from the package. Issues are never added up across packages. Not available before 0.13.0.

steps.name: --fail-on-count=3
steps.note: Passes: no package has 3 issues on its own (3 in total). Warns once per package: --fail-on-count=3 overrides [gate] failOnSeverity = "HIGH" in pkg_a/Scan.toml, and [gate] failOnCount = 5 in pkg_b/Scan.toml.

steps.name: --fail-on-severity=LOW
steps.note: pkg_b does not keep failOnCount = 5, so both packages fail on their first issue: 2 packages failed the gate. Before the whole-table change, only pkg_a failed.

steps.name: --platform-triggered
steps.note: The gate is off when a platform triggers the scan.
